_doc: Generated-party build data (NPC_LEARNING_PLAN.md Step 3b), read by gui/party_gen.py.
classes:    per-class kit (hit die, saves, casting, cantrip/prepared tables, extra ASIs).
builds:     one per (class, role): ability priority, armor kind, weapons, feats, ranked spells.
subclasses: the role table (primary/secondary), signature abilities (B9a), feature choices,
and per-subclass overrides merged over the (class, role) build.
armor kinds: heavy (Chain Mail 16, Plate 18 from L9), medium (14 + DEX max 2, 15 from L5),
light (12 + DEX), mage (13 + DEX, Mage Armor precast), unarmored (10 + DEX, or the
engine's Unarmored Defense for Barbarian / Monk / Dance Bard / Draconic Sorcerer).
Abilities are str dex con intel wis cha, highest first; scores 17 16 14 10 8 8 (B5).

third_caster._doc: Eldritch Knight / Arcane Trickster: the engine supplies the slots; these set what is prepared.
